taxonomy.label: Late Delivery
taxonomy.description: Order delivered late, ETA wrong, order never arrived

taxonomy.label: Wrong / Missing Items
taxonomy.description: Wrong order, missing items, spilled or damaged food

taxonomy.label: Food / Product Quality
taxonomy.description: Stale, cold, bad quality food or groceries, expired products

taxonomy.label: Refund / Cancellation
taxonomy.description: Refund not given, cancellation charges, order cancelled by platform

taxonomy.label: Pricing / Fees
taxonomy.description: High delivery fees, surge, platform fee, price higher than menu

taxonomy.label: Delivery Partner Behaviour
taxonomy.description: Rude or unprofessional delivery agent, asking for extra money

taxonomy.label: Customer Support
taxonomy.description: Chatbot loops, no human support, unresolved complaints

taxonomy.label: App Bug / Payment Issue
taxonomy.description: Crashes, payment failures, coupon not applying, tracking broken

taxonomy.label: Praise / No Issue
taxonomy.description: Positive review, satisfied user, praise for features

taxonomy.label: Other
taxonomy.description: Doesn't fit any other category, or is unintelligible
